{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_count}")

loyal_completed_filtered = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
filtered_count = len(loyal_completed_filtered)
print(f"Number of loyal, completed orders after removing QA orders: {filtered_count}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Return the final value
mean_revenue"}
